proposition: The Prologue states that Ibn Turka was subject to three state inquisitions contrived by jealous and vengeful colleagues, that his first two defences succeeded and the third failed, and that after five years of wandering exile he died impoverished and in legal limbo. It names no dates for the three inquisitions and does not say what source the account rests on.
